abstract_sentences.text: Recent studies operationalize self-improvement through coding agents that edit their own codebases.

evidence.anchor: Recent studies operationalize self-improvement through coding agents that edit their own codebases

abstract_sentences.text: They grow a tree of self-modifications through expansion strategies that favor higher software engineering benchmark performance, assuming that this implies more promising subsequent self-modifications.

evidence.anchor: expansion strategies that favor higher software engineering benchmark performance

abstract_sentences.text: However, we identify a mismatch between the agent’s self-improvement potential (metaproductivity) and its coding benchmark performance, namely the Metaproductivity-Performance Mismatch.

evidence.anchor: a mismatch between the agent’s self-improvement potential and its coding benchmark performance

abstract_sentences.text: Inspired by Huxley’s concept of clade, we propose a metric (CMP) that aggregates the benchmark performances of the descendants of an agent as an indicator of its potential for self-improvement.

evidence.anchor: a metric (CMP) that aggregates the benchmark performances of the descendants

abstract_sentences.text: We show that, in our self-improving coding agent development setting, access to the true CMP is sufficient to simulate how the Gödel Machine would behave under certain assumptions.

evidence.anchor: access to the true CMP is sufficient to simulate how the Gödel Machine would behave

abstract_sentences.text: We introduce the Huxley-Gödel Machine (HGM), which, by estimating CMP and using it as guidance, searches the tree of self-modifications.

evidence.anchor: by estimating CMP and using it as guidance, searches the tree of self-modifications

abstract_sentences.text: On SWE-bench Verified and Polyglot, HGM outperforms prior self-improving coding agent development methods while using fewer allocated CPU hours.

evidence.anchor: HGM outperforms prior self-improving coding agent development methods

abstract_sentences.text: Last but not least, HGM demonstrates strong transfer to other coding datasets and LLMs.

evidence.anchor: HGM demonstrates strong transfer to other coding datasets and LLMs

abstract_sentences.text: The agent optimized by HGM on SWE-bench Verified with GPT-5 mini and evaluated on SWE-bench Lite with GPT-5 achieves human-level performance, matching the best officially checked results of human-engineered coding agents.

evidence.anchor: evaluated on SWE-bench Lite with GPT-5 achieves human-level performance

claim_closure.claim: Immediate benchmark performance can mismatch long-run metaproductivity.
claim_closure.method_response: HGM replaces node-only performance guidance with clade-aggregated counts and target-controlled CMP estimation.
claim_closure.evidence_response: Table 1 reports positive but uneven correlations, with HGM stronger than SICA/DGM in the reported weighted/unweighted settings.

claim_closure.conclusion_response: §6 repeats outperformance and reduced allocated CPU-hours.

claim_closure.claim: HGM is an approximation of the optimal self-improving machine with a quantified approximation quality.
claim_closure.method_response: HGM substitutes a clade-count estimator and Thompson sampling for the true CMP oracle.
claim_closure.evidence_response: The theorem covers the true oracle under Assumption 1; the paper supplies correlations and benchmark outcomes but no estimator error bound, regret bound or oracle gap.
claim_closure.conclusion_response: §6 calls the mechanism promising and compatible with future weight-level modification, without adding a formal approximation guarantee.

final_judgment.single_storyline: 论文把 self-improving coding-agent development 形式化为 tree search：immediate benchmark performance 可能偏离 lineage 的长期 potential；CMP 用 clade descendants 的 aggregate outcomes 近似长期选择价值，true CMP 在 Assumption 1 下等同 specialized Gödel POMDP 的 Qπ，而 HGM 用 counts、Thompson sampling、adaptive scheduling 与 async 执行近似该原则。证据位于 PDF pp.3–6、15–17。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留 MPM 问题、GMP/CMP 定义、Assumption 1、Theorem 1、HGM 三子策略、Table 1–3 与 transfer/成本主结果；这些对象支撑从理论 bridge 到 empirical capability 的决策链。证据位于 PDF pp.4–10。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: Appendix A 放完整 POMDP proof，B 放算法与 async bias，C 放 initial-agent/model/cost details，D 放 target/leakage 公式，E 放 baseline policy matrix，F 放 qualitative code/diff listings。proof 与 estimator construction 依赖附录才可完整审计，但正文仍给出结论和调用点。证据位于 PDF pp.15–31。
final_judgment.best_pattern: 最有效的结构是 assumption → named theorem bridge → explicit policy decomposition → estimator-alignment diagnostic → capability/cost table → dataset/backbone transfer table；Table 1 先处理 MPM，再由 Table 2–3 处理 efficacy 与 generalization。证据位于 PDF pp.4–9。
final_judgment.largest_gap: 实际 HGM 只是 full HGM-Async bundle 的经验 approximation：没有 estimator error/regret/oracle-gap guarantee，也没有 CMP、scheduler、evaluation policy、best-belief 或 async 的 component ablation；点估计、filtered 分母和 leaderboard 外部比较还限制稳定性与可比性。证据位于 PDF pp.6–9、18–21。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 将理论 oracle 落地为 empirical estimator 时，应在 theorem 旁同时给出假设、target、leakage control 与 approximation diagnostic，并用 component-matched experiments 分离 capability、runtime 与 mechanism attribution。该规则从 PDF pp.5–8、20–21 的证据归纳。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 若研究只证明理论 equivalence 或组件无法独立运行，完整 component ablation 可不适用；此时必须把不可识别的机制归因保留为 open。HGM 的三子策略已被分开定义，因此本边界不能替代其 CMP/async 分离评估。证据位于 PDF p.6、21。
